newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Ross awards A$61.6 mln mine contract.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Ross awards A$61.6 mln mine contract.

text.p: Ross Mining NL said on Thursday it had awarded a A$61.6 million contract to J.R. Engineering Services Pty Ltd to design and construct its Gold Ridge mine project in the Solomon Islands.
Construction is scheduled to commence at the end of March following the issue of a government mining lease and relocation of local landowners to the Lungga village, Ross said.
The mining lease is scheduled to be granted on March 12, Ross said.
The contract is also subject to board approval and ratification by one of the financiers, Ross said.

The contract calls for design and construction of a two million tonne per year carbon-in-pulp processing plant and a provisional sum for the design and construction of infrastructure including all facilities, tailings dams and associated tailings disposal systems, Ross said.
The plant is scheduled to produce 100,000 ounces of gold per year.
